description: Research-only hypothetical combined Solar+Wind model predictions from non-synchronized historical samples. One solar source and one wind turbine; not a measured farm or dispatch.

renewable_power.inputs_provenance: Solar historical row in October 2014; Wind relative-calendar row with no verified matching calendar date. Matching clock features does NOT prove simultaneous observations; model outputs are hypothetically combined.

baseline_provenance: Original sample_id=1511, observed renewable_power_kw=199.910; fixed scenario power is 200 kW and six controls are copied from this observed record.
bounds_basis: Empirical 5th–95th percentile per feature; not safety limits; does not establish joint-distribution support.

energy_benchmark.source: U.S. DOE 2022 alkaline electrolyzer reference system energy benchmark; illustrative assumption, not measured system SEC

fuel_cell.operating_point_provenance: Numeric medians of historically labelled Pass rows; hypothetical setpoint, NOT verified connected hydrogen-fuel-cell device configuration.
fuel_cell.flow_demand_provenance: Median observed historical Fuel Cell Pass flow, not a measured demand from the candidate electrolyzer.
